blocks.text: KADINGILAN, Bukidnon — A 100-year-old resident from the municipality of Kadingilan has added her name to the growing roster of centenarians in Bukidnon, following national and local government recognition of her community contributions. Anacleta Balonda Ramonida officially became Bukidnon’s 33rd recorded centenarian—comprising 23 females and 10 males—receiving ₱100,000 in cash incentives and food packs under the Centenarians Act of 2016 (Republic Act No. 10868).
